name: NIBE Industrier AB (publ)
summary: NIBE Industrier AB (publ), trading under the symbol NIABY, is a Swedish corporation specializing in the development, manufacturing, global marketing, and sale of energy-efficient systems designed for comfortable indoor environments. The company also provides advanced components and solutions for intelligent heating and control. Its extensive operations reach across the Nordic countries, the broader European continent, North America, and other international markets. The company's activities are structured into three primary business segments: 1. NIBE Climate Solutions: This division focuses on delivering products that ensure optimal indoor climate comfort and air quality. Its diverse portfolio includes heat pumps, ventilation and air conditioning systems, comprehensive climate control solutions, water heaters, thermal storage tanks, district heating components, solar panels (PV), domestic boilers, and commercial-grade laundry equipment like washing machines and tumble dryers. These offerings cater to a wide range of properties, from individual homes and apartment complexes to large commercial establishments. 2. NIBE Element: Dedicated to sophisticated heating and control technology, this segment supplies a broad spectrum of specialized components. Its offerings encompass various heating elements (e.g., tubular, foil, ceramic, high-power), open spirals, heating cables, vacuum brazing solutions, heat pump technology components, resistors, heat exchangers, temperature sensors, flexible hoses, and control equipment. These components are vital to numerous sectors, including household and commercial appliances, professional kitchen equipment, energy generation, transportation, advanced technology, medical devices, aviation, and a variety of industrial projects. 3. NIBE Stoves: This segment provides a selection of heating appliances and related systems. Its product line features various types of stoves, such as free-standing, wood-burning, gas, and electric models. Additionally, the division supplies heat-retaining products, chimney systems, and essential accessories. NIBE Industrier AB (publ) was founded in 1949 and is headquartered in Markaryd, Sweden.
